integrity: Definitions, characteristic-free proof, exact parameter count and a standalone pair-orbit checker are supplied. Computational spot checks are not substituted for the theorem. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact census concerns the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra, not all higher-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebras.
The arbitrary-field theorem classifies maps that need not be surjective over infinite fields; finite-field bijectivity is a separate deduction.
The exact general formula is proved by orbit-witness analysis. Exhaustive enumeration was feasible only over F_2; F_3 and F_4 checks sampled parameterized maps.
Complete access to the 2024/2025 Heisenberg linear-two-local paper was unavailable; absolute literature priority is not established.
title: Projective-and-fiber classification of all two-local automorphisms of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra
